spec.name: backend-sandbox-rep-4
spec.type: Small backend deploy setup (sandbox) — deploy configuration only, no build/app code in scope
spec.stack: Node backend (NestJS/Express-style, mirroring the Revealer sandbox: `npm run build` → `dist/`). Deployed to the Azure sandbox VM (django-vm, host 52.180.154.225) via the SAME shared deploy engine Revealer uses — `workspace/shared/infra/deploy_changes.py` driven by this project's own `deploy/deploy-config.json` delta plus the generated `deploy/backend-sandbox-rep-4.config.sh`. SSH/rsync as user `mostafa` (password from `oth/.cred` key `azvmcred`, password auth forced), rsync `--checksum`, firewall rotation (single current IP, port only) via the Azure control plane; ports 80/443/22 and the reverse proxy are never touched. No nginx, no domain, internal port only.
spec.description: SECOND SANDBOX, rep 4. Set up DEPLOYMENT for a NEW small backend to our sandbox Azure VM using the SAME deployment approach the Revealer sandbox project (revealer-6978) already uses — i.e. the shared generic engine `workspace/shared/infra/deploy_changes.py` configured by this project's OWN delta at `workspace/projects/backend-sandbox-rep-4/deploy/deploy-config.json` (plus the generated `deploy/backend-sandbox-rep-4.config.sh`), exactly like Revealer and the earlier reps. KEY DIFFERENCES FROM REVEALER, VERBATIM: (1) this backend MUST NOT run database migrations on every deploy — set `migration:"none"` for its target (`CFG_BACKEND_MIG="none"`), so NO `prisma migrate`/migrate step ever runs on any deploy; (2) it uses its OWN dedicated folder on the VM (NOT the Revealer folder, NOT the rep-2 folder, NOT any production folder) — `/home/mostafa/sandbox-rep4/backend`, local source `_external/VolatileWorkSpace/rep4-backend`; (3) it runs on PORT 4200 (`CFG_BACKEND_PORT="4200"`). Backend-only (no frontend target, unlike Revealer which had both). SANDBOX ONLY: must NEVER touch production folders (organics/bendcore/django) or the Revealer/rep-2 sandbox folders, NEVER use `--delete` outside its own folder, NEVER change ports 80/443/22 or the reverse proxy — any firewall rotation touches only the owner's current IP/port exactly like Revealer. Deploy mechanics mirror Revealer exactly: rsync as user `mostafa` over SSH (forced password auth from `oth/.cred`), rsync `--checksum` so changed files overwrite by content, excludes `.env*`/`node_modules`/`dist`/`logs` plus the engine's default secret/backup excludes, build command `rm -rf dist && npm run build`, and verification of each command's REAL exit code with a post-deploy health check (`curl -s localhost:4200/...` over SSH). SCOPE OF THIS REQUEST: PREPARE THE DEPLOY SETUP ONLY — author the project folder, `deploy/deploy-config.json` (one backend target, migration none, port 4200, own VM folder), the generated `*.config.sh`, and wire it to the shared engine. DO NOT DEPLOY NOW; do not rsync, build, seed, migrate, or start anything on the VM yet.
